label: Graded necessary support, from J2
meaning: Converse of the graded J2 route: J2 already yields some rigid comparison with no infinite ascent that support between necessary concreta ascends. With unionWFOfAscent the two are equivalent when the grade may be chosen freely. The rigid-grade premise is therefore not weaker than J2; what it adds is that the grade is the one of being shared with the grades-to-maximum route.
